exposure: previous placenta-mediated complications (hypertensive disorders, preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, placental abruption, small for gestational age (SGA)) in first and second deliveries
number and order of previous complications
outcome: placenta-mediated complications (hypertensive disorders, preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, placental abruption, small for gestational age (SGA)) in the third delivery
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who had their first three consecutive deliveries at a single medical center between 1994 and 2013, excluding those with multiple gestations or fetal anomalies.
finding: The number and order of previous placenta-mediated complications in the first two deliveries are significant risk factors for recurrence in the third delivery, with the risk increasing dose-dependently with more prior complications.
birth_weight: SGA (less than the 10th percentile) was an outcome measure.
gest_age: SGA (defined by gestational age) was an outcome measure.
